title: Sign in to continue
body: Your session ended. Sign in with an email magic link to return to this task.
detail: Last confirmed draft: saved. Recent unsaved edits remain in this preview only. On a shared device, do not display private task text before verification.

title: Send yourself a magic link
body: Sign-up and login use the same email-only flow.
detail: Production must validate a same-origin return destination and restore only the verified learner’s work.

title: Check your email
body: If the request is accepted, a sign-in link will arrive shortly.
detail: This preview sends no email. In production, preserve the authorised return path through explicit confirmation.

title: Let’s find a supported goal
body: The pilot does not offer your requested course yet. Choose a supported goal or revise yours.
detail: Your original goal stays available for editing. No course is enrolled by viewing suggestions.

title: We could not load course suggestions
body: Your saved goal and preferences are still here. Try again when your connection is ready.
detail: A failed request is different from an unsupported goal. Do not invent a course or erase input.

title: This task needs more time
body: Your next independent task is estimated at 20 minutes. You selected 10 minutes.
detail: Choose a short refresher, or return when you have more time. A refresher does not replace the independent task or lower its criteria.

title: Get help with this task?
body: A learning-assistant hint will make this attempt assisted. It will count as practice, not independent demonstration.
detail: Screen readers, zoom and equivalent text do not make an attempt assisted. Practice AI remains a permitted tool in Practical AI.

title: You’re practising with support
body: Assisted attempt. Your work is still here and you can continue learning.
detail: Production records assistance before delivering the hint. Use a fresh task later to demonstrate independently. No worked solution is included in this design.

title: Save your work before leaving
body: Some edits have not been saved. Stay to continue editing or retry saving before you leave.
detail: Never show a successful-save message until the server confirms it. If you discard unsaved edits, keep the last confirmed draft.

title: There’s a newer saved draft
body: This task changed in another session. Choose what to inspect before saving.
detail: Keep both revisions recoverable. Do not silently overwrite newer work. Production shows timestamps and lets you compare authorised revisions.

title: Request an optional review?
body: A reviewer will receive this submitted attempt, its criterion feedback and assistance history.
detail: Review does not delay learning or practice. No new demonstration is awarded while the assessment is uncertain. Show privacy scope before submission.

title: Review request recorded
body: Your submitted attempt stays unchanged. Continue learning while the request is pending.
detail: Preview only. Production reuses the same request identity to prevent duplicates. A reviewer response is not promised immediately.

title: Choose your starting point
body: Optional starting questions help suggest a module. They do not award achievement.
detail: Course selected: Practical AI. Production uses four to six reviewed questions with saved answers and an always-visible skip. This design illustrates the response transition, not a complete diagnostic.

title: A suggested starting point
body: Illustrative placement: start with Write clear prompts. You can choose module one instead.
detail: Reason: the example response identifies a task but omits an output constraint. This is a provisional placement, not demonstrated ability. All diagnostic answers remain inspectable.

title: Choose an available teaching language
body: Igbo lesson content is awaiting review. Your draft and language preference stay unchanged.
detail: English is available in this design example only. No real language release is claimed. Do not silently switch the default or translate an assessment with unreviewed content.

title: Your task is ready to continue
body: Your confirmed draft has been restored in this illustrative preview.
detail: Production must verify ownership before restoring work. No real learner draft or achievement is loaded here.
